Waterfall walk · Naena Falls (Naena-no-taki)

Drive Nagano Sta → Suzaka-Nagano-Higashi IC → Jōshin'etsu Expwy → Myōkō-Kōgen IC → ~15 min of local road, ~1 h 10 in all (est.)

MC 469 046 579*87 (car park)

One of Japan's 100 best waterfalls: a 55 m drop over a basalt-column wall. Car park → viewpoint ~15 min each way on a built path with two narrow suspension bridges, steps and wet rock; EH & BY can stop at the first bridge. Free; toilets may be shut late in the season. Foliage peaked in late Oct, so expect bare trees by 14 Nov. The ~1.5 km access road and the path close once snow settles (not ploughed; no fixed 2026 date). Early frost makes the bridges and rock slick: turn back if icy
Leave by 10:40 to make the 13:32 trolley
If closed, snowy or icy: skip it and drive straight to Unazuki for the 12:50 trolley
